ideas.title: 4 Bedroom Luxury Industrial Villa
highlights: Private pool, hot tub and BBQ area
Pool table, arcade machine and board games
Concrete industrial fit-out with a big open-plan living room
ideas.notes: Host Eka averages 4.33★ over 18 reviews on his other places and replies within the hour. The header says 4 bedrooms but the description mentions more, so worth asking. No smoke or CO alarm listed.

ideas.title: Sunset View: Chic 4BR Villa
highlights: Private pool
Outdoor kitchen with grill
Daily housekeeping
ideas.notes: Booked out 31 Dec and 1 Jan, so we'd need somewhere else for New Year's Eve. $623/night with a 10% early booking discount, and the total includes $168 tax. Run by Balinest Villas, a big Superhost manager with 4.86★ over 10,000+ reviews. Dalung is a bit inland from central Canggu.
ideas.unavailable: Only free 2–5 Jan, 3 of our 5 Canggu nights

ideas.title: Seaside Luxury 4BR Villa, 400m to Finns
highlights: Private pool with sun beds
Outdoor lounge and tropical garden
Walk to Finns and the beach
ideas.notes: Superhost Rachel, 10 years hosting. $802/night with a 10% early booking discount ($401 off) already taken out of the total. The listing also mentions a discount because of construction nearby, so expect some daytime noise.
ideas.cancel: Free cancellation for 24 hours after booking

ideas.title: Villa Kayura by BaliSuperHost
ideas.notes: Run by BaliSuperHost, a big villa manager. Photos, details and price still to come.

ideas.title: MODJO Villas Bingin
ideas.location: Bingin, about a 6 min walk to Bingin Beach
highlights: Private pool
All bedrooms have their own bathroom and air con
Short walk to Bingin Beach, cafés and Alchemy
Padang Padang beach 5 min drive
ideas.notes: Photos and price still to come.

ideas.title: Castle Lunita: Ocean View, Cinema & Gym
ideas.location: Clifftop Uluwatu, 10 min walk to Blue Point and Suluban beaches
highlights: Private pool, sauna, cinema room and home gym
Panoramic Indian Ocean views
Outdoor kitchen with grill
Every bedroom has its own bathroom
ideas.notes: Superhost Edo, who guests say is very responsive. The listing mentions road construction down the valley until Dec 2026 (with a price drop), usually quiet on the villa side. Price still to come.

ideas.title: Luxury Villa AV1
highlights: Private pool with sun loungers and garden
Double-height open-plan living and dining
Master bedroom with a freestanding bath
ideas.notes: Booking.com's page name says 2BR, so the number of bedrooms needs checking. Price still to come.

ideas.title: New 5BR Villa, 200m to the Beach
highlights: Private pool and tropical garden
Every bedroom has its own bathroom
Fast Wi-Fi, about 100 Mbps
Part of a new complex of 6 villas
Walk to St. Ali and Pererenan cafés
ideas.notes: The only 5-bedroom option, so nobody shares if Jasmine comes. Pererenan is quieter than central Canggu, about 10 minutes' drive to Batu Bolong. Price still to come.
